{{Quote|&hellip;Lantern birds are servants of the Spirit and sacred. They must always be free.|Warok|<ref name="TAOT" />}}
The '''lantern birds''' were large flying creatures with incandescent tail feathers. They lived in shimmering nests high in the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor's forest moon]]. The lantern birds' tail feathers were used by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] for medicinal potions. These avians were often eaten by [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]], but the Ewoks considered them to be magical.
